name: Lyo.Web.WebRenderer
tagline: Server-side Razor rendering and HTML capture to PDF, PNG, JPEG, or WebP through one shared Chromium process.
description: Server-side Razor rendering uses `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web.HtmlRenderer`. HTML capture uses one shared Chromium process (PuppeteerSharp) and writes PDF, PNG, JPEG, or WebP into a caller-owned stream. Request and response types live in `Lyo.Web.WebRenderer.Models` so a host can pass `WebRenderReq` without referencing the browser.

sections.title: `IWebRendererService` methods
sections.text: Three families of operations sit on the service, plus three observability events.

sections.title: Render Razor components to HTML
rows: HTML string for component `T : IComponent`. Generic, `Type`, and FullName-string overloads share one code path (`LyoTypeInfo.TryResolveClrType`).
HTML string that passes a strongly-typed options object as the `Options` parameter.

sections.title: Turn HTML into PDF
rows: PDF bytes from an HTML string.
PDF bytes from an HTML file on disk.
End-to-end file → file (PDF path defaults to `<htmlFilePath>.pdf` when null).
sections.trail: `CopyCaptureToAsync` writes PDF, PNG, JPEG, or WebP into a stream you own. `ConvertHtmlToPdfAsync` is the PDF bytes wrapper. `IWebRenderGenerator.GenerateAsync` writes `WebRenderReq.OutputFilePath` and returns `WebRenderRes`. A CSS `@page` size wins when `PreferCssPageSize` is true; otherwise the named paper is used and A4 is the fallback.

sections.title: Events
sections.text: `ComponentRenderedToBytes`, `ComponentRendered`, `ComponentSavedToFile` fire after the matching render operations and carry the resulting payload plus parameter and options snapshots, used for archival or diffing.

sections.title: Options ([`WebRenderOptions`](WebRenderOptions.cs))
rows: Chromium/Chrome executable path PuppeteerSharp uses for HTML→PDF.
When `true` and an `IMetrics` is registered, records one timer, success counter, failure counter, and size gauge per operation.
How many captures may use the shared browser at once.
How long a page may take to load HTML and produce a capture. Cancellation closes the page.
Adds `--no-sandbox`. Leave false outside containers. `--disable-dev-shm-usage` is always passed.
sections.lead: `WebRenderOptions` is the configuration section name. `Validate` requires `MaxConcurrentPages` of at least 1, a positive `ContentTimeout`, and an existing file when `BrowserExePath` is set. An unset path is legal so HTML-only hosts still boot.
sections.trail:
Metrics stay off unless `EnableMetrics` is true. Names are `webrenderer.render_to_html`, `webrenderer.render_to_html_bytes`, `webrenderer.render_to_file`, `webrenderer.capture`, and `webrenderer.browser.launch`, each with `.duration`, `.success`, and `.failure`. Capture and render also record size gauges. Tags are `component_type`, `operation`, and `format`.

Logs: Information when the browser launches and shuts down, Debug when a render or capture starts, Warning with the exception on failure. A subscriber that throws is logged and the HTML is still returned.

sections.title: Register in DI ([`Extensions.cs`](Extensions.cs))
sections.text: `AddWebRendererService(Action<WebRenderOptions>)`, `AddWebRendererService(WebRenderOptions)`, and `AddWebRendererServiceFromConfiguration` register options, a singleton `BrowserSession`, a scoped `HtmlRenderer`, and a scoped `WebRendererService` as `IWebRendererService` and `IWebRenderGenerator`. `TryAdd` keeps a host registration. `ILogger<WebRendererService>` is required. `IMetrics` is used only when `EnableMetrics` is true.
